<?php
function first152() { echo "first|"; return 1; }
function second152() { echo "second|"; return 2; }
function third152() { echo "third|"; return 3; }
function fourth152() { echo "fourth|"; return 4; }
function extra152() { echo "extra|"; return 5; }
function later152() { echo "later|"; return 6; }
echo "before|";
$one = new class(first152(), second152(), third152(), fourth152()) {};
echo $one::class, "|";
try {
    $two = new class(first152(), second152(), third152(), fourth152(), extra: extra152(), later: later152()) {};
} catch (Error $e) {
    echo "caught|", $e->getMessage(), "|";
}
$tail = new class {};
echo $tail::class, "|after";

<?php
class Base152Review { public int $sum = 0; }
eval(<<<'CODE'
namespace Later152Review;
use Base152Review as B;
function first152Review() {
    static $bad = true;
    echo "first|";
    if ($bad) { $bad = false; return "bad"; }
    return 1;
}
function fourth152Review() { echo "fourth|"; return 4; }
function third152Review() { echo "third|"; return 3; }
function make152Review() {
    return new class(fourth: fourth152Review(), first: first152Review(), third: third152Review()) extends B {
        public function __construct(int $first, string $second = "default", int $third = 30, int $fourth = 40) {
            echo "ctor|", $second, "|";
            $this->sum = $first + $third + $fourth;
        }
    };
}
try { make152Review(); } catch (\TypeError $error) { echo $error->getMessage(), "|"; }
$a = make152Review();
$b = make152Review();
echo $a::class, "|", $a->sum, "|", ($a::class === $b::class), "|", ($a !== $b), "|";
CODE);

<?php
echo "outer|";
eval(<<<'CODE'
false && (new class {
    public function __construct(int $first = 'bad', string $second = 's', int $third = 3, int $fourth = 4) {}
});
echo 'pruned|';
CODE);
echo "middle|";
eval(<<<'CODE'
function unused152Review() {
    return new class {
        public function __construct(int $first = 1, string $second = 's', int $third = 3, int $fourth = 'bad') {}
    };
}
echo 'never|';
CODE);
echo "after|";
